purpose: Independently read and adjudicate the 50 new EMC trial-scope labels so the reference can support later evaluation. This does not complete the remaining 74 comparator pairs.
before_prior_labels: Read OPERATING_PROTOCOL.md and the source-only packet, generic label protocol and frozen work order. Do not read first-reader-labels.json, judgments-*.json, the expansion decision memo, or their summaries before freezing independent judgments.

Inspect complete original eligibility, descriptions, conditions, arms/cohorts, design/purpose and status for every record. Preserve uncertainty and additional requirements; no binary patient eligibility or live-slot inference.
Write independent labels with exact source pointers/excerpts, cohort reconciliation and separate molecular/variant/protocol/purpose uncertainty. Record completed IDs honestly.
Freeze exact input/output hashes and timestamp before reading prior labels. Procedural separation is not a technical access barrier or human clinical review.
after_freeze: Read the original first-reader-labels.json and compare all fields that affect disease scope or benchmark use.
Resolve substantive differences against complete original records; preserve both readers and source-linked dispositions. Do not force disagreement or majority voting.
Retain unresolvable differences as uncertainty; do not improve retrieval scores by changing labels.
Provide deterministic reproduction, coverage and source checks, manuscript-use limits, timing and actual execution evidence. Coordinator checks remain separate.
coordination: No outgoing task status messages, nested tasks, agents, runners, cleanup, installs or network needed. Coordinator reserves before scientific writing and polls.
completion_limit: A durable checkpoint is an intermediate outcome; only mark a worker goal complete if its actual bounded objective is satisfied. Full manuscript, independent ultra review and publication gates remain the parent goal.
